name: serie-a-news-php
description: Serie A news aggregator (PHP) - npm scripts only proxy PHP linting/test, no JS build step.

scripts.build: for f in index.php fetch.php lib/*.php; do php -l "$f" || exit 1; done && echo 'PHP lint OK'
scripts.lint: for f in index.php fetch.php lib/*.php; do php -l "$f" || exit 1; done
